title: ID0419120-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000692] CCS connector issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: There is a problem on the CCS cable of this charger (CCS3, cable at the right of the charger). Indeed, we can see that the DC- pin blades are offset which can cause overheating problems. Can you plan an intervention with the french team please to change the CCS connector.
Solution: N/A
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-04-15
